title: Record of a change
description: One TOML file per pull request under changes/. It lists, per touched item, the identifier and the kind of change.

changes.description: An array of tables ([[changes]]), one per touched item.

kind.description: stricter is incompatible and raises the major version (the title needs the breaking marker !). added, relaxed, retired and announced raise the minor version (the title type rule, relax, retire or announce respectively; feat is not used). editorial raises the patch version.
